title: Circular - Launch of e-SCR of Supreme Court of India - Gujarat High Court
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
IT CELL
CIRCULAR
Date: 13th January, 2023
Launch of electronic version of Supreme Court of Report (e-SCR)
by Hon’ble Supreme Court of India
As directed by Hon’ble the Chief Justice, this is to convey for benefit
of all the stakeholders that, Hon’ble the Supreme Court of India has
launched a digital version of judgments of the Supreme Court of India as
reported in ‘Supreme Court Reports’. The eSCR can be accessed free of
cost by anyone and everyone at https://judgments.ecourts.gov.in. It can
also be availed from the Supreme Court website at sci.gov.in and the
mobile application of the Supreme Court.
e-SCR will facilitate access to the judgments of the Supreme Court,
free of subscription or any other expense for the user. The database of
e-SCR contains at present about 34,000 reported judgments of the
Supreme Court. The search facility e-SCR provides search based on the
following criteria:
● Free text search
● Search within search
● Case type search
● Case year search
● Judge search
● Judgement Year and Volume search
● Bench strength search
All the stakeholders including judicial officers, lawyers, law clerks,
law students, researchers, law universities/colleges, other educational
institutions, state judicial academy, litigants, civic society and the public at
large would benefit from the free facilities of e-SCR.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR GENERAL
To:
1. PPS to all the Ho’ble Judges of the High Court with request place this
before the Hon’ble Judges
2. Ld. Advocate General, Ld. Government Pleader, Ld. Public Prosecutor
3. Bar Council of Gujarat with request to upload on their website
4. Gujarat High Court Advocates’ Association (GHCAA) with request to
circulate amongst members of the Bar
5. Director, Gujarat State Judicial Academy (GSJA) for awareness of all
trainee Judicial Officers
6. Judges’ Library, High Court of Gujarat to make regular use of e-SCR
7. Deputy Registrar(PS Cell) to circulate amongst all the Law Clerks
8. All the Judicial Officers to their Official Email Address for regular use
of e-SCR for their legal research and reference requirements
9. All the Ld. Advocates whose email address is available in CIS of the
High Court or the District Judiciary of Gujarat
10. To upload on Gujarat High Court website and Telegram Channel
Copy for kind information to:
Ld. Secretary General, Supreme Court of India
